title: Repeat-Recovery Surcharge on Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Transport Charges
content:
**Training note — repeat recoveries, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

A vehicle the agency has had to recover before carries a repeat-recovery surcharge on the transport charge for its involuntary recovery under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract. The surcharge is counted from the repossession agency fees posted on the contract's account history.

| Repossession agency fees posted on the contract | Repeat-recovery surcharge |
|---|---|
| Three or more | third-recovery surcharge, $60.00 |
| Exactly two | second-recovery surcharge, $30.00 |
| Exactly one | none |
| None posted | none |

**Q. What is counted?** Only repossession agency fees posted on this contract — the agency fee entries of the kind booked for a recovery. Transport, storage and condition-report entries are not counted, and agency fees on another Kestrel contract are not counted.

**Q. Does a fourth recovery cost more than a third?** No. Three or more agency fees carry the same $60.00 third-recovery surcharge.

**Q. A contract shows two agency fees. What is the surcharge?** $30.00, the second-recovery surcharge.

**Q. A contract shows one agency fee, or none at all. What is the surcharge?** None.
